paper: NGD-SLAM: Towards Real-Time Dynamic SLAM without GPU (IROS 2025)
recorded_with: reproduce.py: official repo yuhaozhang7/NGD-SLAM @a93a14c, TUM fr3/walking_xyz, all 827 frames, headless, median of 3 trials
note: ATE and RPE-translation reproduce the paper. Rotational RPE does not under the RMSE convention (0.604 vs 0.470) but does under the mean (0.475) - the paper's column header does not say which statistic it reports. The system is thread-parallel, so single runs vary more than the gap to the paper; the reported values are medians of 3 trials and the per-trial spread is recorded.

environment.viewer: disabled in Examples/RGB-D/rgbd_tum.cc (one line) - see work/local_patches.patch
environment.build: -j3; -j10 gets OOM-killed on a 15 GB machine
environment.sophus: NOT built - the project only uses its headers (CMakeLists.txt:49)
